result.summary: Found several layout and content issues, mainly involving cut-off elements at the screen edge and category filter row.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccolo' restaurant card and its details are cut off at the right edge of the screen in the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll views clip properly or add partial-card indication so users know more content is scrollable.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off on the right edge, hiding additional categories.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient edge or partial visible next item to indicate scrollability.

issues.description: The '-100%' discount badge on the pizza promo at the bottom is ambiguous and could confuse users (100% off may look like a display error).
issues.suggestion: Clarify the promotion text, e.g. 'Free Delivery' or '100% off first order' with more context.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the ramen bar image has a white outline while the pizza promo below has a dark circular background, creating inconsistent icon styling across cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon style (background, color, opacity) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotional card is abruptly cropped at the bottom of the screen without clear indication of scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual cue (e.g., partial fade) to indicate more content is below.
